description: Executable coding-agent benchmark tasks. Each task is copied into an isolated workspace and graded outside that workspace.

tasks.prompt: Fix the exported calculateDiscount(price, percent) behavior. Percent is a percentage from 0 through 100, so 20 means a 20% discount. Preserve the public function name. Reject non-finite price/percent values with TypeError and percentages outside 0..100 with RangeError. Add or improve focused tests if useful. Do not change the requested semantics just to satisfy an existing implementation.
